Aug 12, 2026
FriskAI, a Los Angeles company that monitors autonomous AI agents as they operate, has closed a funding round led by MaC Venture Capital. Wischoff Ventures and Detroit Venture Partners joined the financing. The startup declined to disclose its valuation. The company's platform sits around agent runtimes, capturing detailed traces of each action an autonomous system takes in production: which tools it calls, what arguments it passes, what it returns, how long operations take. From those traces, FriskAI builds behavioral profiles and flags when an agent deviates from expected patterns. Teams don't set thresholds or write detection rules themselves; the system learns normal behavior and surfaces anomalies automatically. FriskAI offers software development kits for Python and TypeScript, with native adapters for LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, and Strands. According to the company's website, the monitoring layer adds minimal performance overhead to tool calls.

...

According to a paper titled "Runtime Compliance Verification for AI Agents" that appeared on arXiv, offline testing methods fall short for AI agents, and runtime verification becomes necessary once agents operate autonomously. FriskAI is running an early-access program for its platform. The company has not yet disclosed customer names or detailed growth plans.

FriskAI Inc., a runtime intelligence startup, has raised $3.6 million in a seed funding round led by MaC Venture Capital Management. The funding aims to bolster the company's development of a platform that provides enterprises with detailed records of their artificial intelligence (AI) agents' activities once deployed. The platform is positioned to address a critical gap in understanding and managing AI agents, which, unlike conventional software, can operate with a degree of unpredictability when subjected to varying inputs or objectives.

The funds will be directed towards expanding FriskAI's engineering team, enhancing market reach, and refining its behavioral analysis capabilities. Additionally, the company plans to accelerate customer deployments. Built using Python and TypeScript software development kits, FriskAI's platform includes prebuilt adapters for integration with technologies like LangChain and Claude Agent SDK.

snippets.snippet: Round — Lead investor — FriskAI Inc., a runtime intelligence startup, has raised $3.6 million in a seed funding round led by MaC Venture Capital Management. The funding aims to bolster the company's development of a platform that provides enterprises with detailed records of their artificial intelligence (AI) agents' activities once deployed. The platform is positioned to address a critical gap in understanding and managing AI agents, which, unlike conventional software, can operate with a degree of unpredictability when subjected to varying inputs or objectives. The funds will be directed towards expanding FriskAI's engineering team, enhancing market reach, and refining its behavioral analysis capabilities. Additionally, the company plans to accelerate customer deployments.
